# Runs Listing & Runner Tab Checklist: Runs Are Visible While They Run

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements — run-listing data consistency, Runner tab state transitions, and secrets exposure of in-progress runs
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`, then run: every item was evaluated against spec/plan/contracts; failing items were fixed in the artifacts before ticking.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is "in progress" defined by exact run statuses rather than a loose description? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — `running` or `paused`; finished = completed/stopped/stopped on error (Key Entities).
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements stated for both listing surfaces (Runner Runs view and the AI client's `runs list`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — both named in FR-001; contract `contracts/runs-list.md` covers the binding and the MCP tool.
- [x] CHK003 - Is the content of an in-progress run's summary specified field by field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — requests completed, tests passed/failed/skipped, elapsed time; contract item 4 maps them to `total_requests`, `tests_*`, `duration_ms`.
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for what the Runs view offers on an in-progress row (Delete) and for Clear runs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010] — no Delete; Clear keeps the in-progress run and is disabled with no stored run.
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for when the Runs list is read again during a run? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008] — when a progress report names a run the already-read list lacks.
- [x] CHK006 - Is the trigger for the tab following a run defined precisely (what counts as "starts")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] — first progress report that reaches the app for a run the tab does not already show; research R5 defines it as "not yet the target's active run".

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the ordering key and the tie-break for equal start times specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — fixed during this run: FR-002 now states equal start times keep the stored order.
- [x] CHK008 - Is the de-duplication winner stated for the moment a run is both stored and in progress? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — the stored copy; research R2 shows why the overlap exists (store before release).
- [x] CHK009 - Is "follow once" unambiguous about later progress after the user opens an older run? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, US2 AS-6] — later progress must not pull the tab back.
- [x] CHK010 - Is "a tab whose Runner has been opened this session" clear about tabs never opened? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases] — nothing to switch; opening it later shows the in-progress run (existing behaviour).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 - Do the list rules agree with the get rules so that every gettable run is listable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §SC-001] — get = in-progress or stored, list = in-progress ∪ stored; plan "Unchanged and confirmed: Get".
- [x] CHK012 - Is following a run started elsewhere consistent with what the tab's own Start does (Results view of the new run, same controls)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, Context table] — both switch to Results; same Pause/Resume/Stop.
- [x] CHK013 - Is FR-009 (no Delete on in-progress rows) consistent with the existing backend refusal? [Consistency, Spec §Context] — deleting an active run is already refused (`delete_runs.go` `ActiveConflict`); UI stops offering it.
- [x] CHK014 - Is the Clear-runs requirement consistent with what Clear actually deletes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Context table] — Clear deletes the stored folder only; the in-progress run stays.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Are the success criteria objectively measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-004] — 100% list⊇get, within one progress report, never listed twice, one click to stop.
- [x] CHK016 - Does every functional requirement map to at least one acceptance scenario or named test? [Traceability, plan.md Tests table] — FR-001…FR-013 each mapped (FR-013 to the unchanged DTO shape).

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 - Are crossed events (progress arriving after the finish) addressed for both the tab and the running indicator? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011] — neither switches nor reappears.
- [x] CHK018 - Is target isolation specified for nested targets (a folder inside a listed collection)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012] — fixed during this run: a folder is its own target, in both directions.
- [x] CHK019 - Is workspace isolation specified for listing and for the tab? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012] — other workspaces never listed nor change a tab; plan Constitution I records why no new scenario is needed.
- [x] CHK020 - Is the behaviour of Clear runs while the tab follows the in-progress run specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — fixed during this run: the tab keeps showing it.
- [x] CHK021 - Are performance runs covered by the listing rules? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — listed in progress like functional runs; their summary includes performance figures when a report exists (tasks T007); throttled progress out of scope.
- [x] CHK022 - Is the user-mid-edit-on-Setup case addressed so following a run cannot lose edits? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — switching views keeps and remembers Setup edits.

## Non-Functional Requirements (Security)

- [x] CHK023 - Does the spec bound what a listed in-progress run may expose, given in-progress rows are not yet masked? [Security, Spec §FR-013] — fixed during this run: FR-013 limits list entries to summary fields and forbids request/response/header/variable values; plan Constitution II confirms the list DTO has no row fields.
- [x] CHK024 - Is it stated that `get` of an in-progress run is unchanged by this feature (no new exposure path)? [Security, plan.md Constitution II] — "`get` of an in-progress run is unchanged by this feature".

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 - Is the one-in-progress-run-per-target assumption grounded in an enforced rule? [Assumption, Spec §Context, research R4] — second start refused (`Claim` → `RUN-02409`), locked by `mcp/runner.feature` "An AI client lists stored runs and stops an active one".
- [x] CHK026 - Is the interplay with the 25-stored-runs limit documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — the limit applies to stored runs; the in-progress run is listed in addition.
